cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will understand the basic principles of plant breeding and cultivar development of common crops with respect to their biological differences and the way of reproduction. The current advances in plant breeding including the use of molecular genetics and biotechnology will be also discussed.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Genetic diversity and its importance for breeding, conservation and utilisation of plant genetic resources (allowance 1/0)2.Genetic variation, intraspecific and interspecific hybridisation, induced mutagenesis, polyploidy (allowance 1/1)3.Selection for monogenic and polygenic traits, phenotypic and genotypic selection, molecular markers (allowance 1/1)4.Breeding of autogamous species, pedigree, bulk and single seed descent methods in early generations, double haploid lines, backcrossing (allowance 1/3)5.Breeding of allogamous species, heterosis (allowance 1/3)6.Breeding of clonally propagated species (allowance 1/0)7.Genetic engineering techniques, genetically modified crops (allowance 1/0)8.Varietal testing, registration and recommendation (allowance 1/0)
